log.msg: SIX WORDS, sixth visit (delta from visit 5: 5/5/5/4/5/4). simple 5 -> 5. powerful 5 -> 5. organized 5 -> 5. intuitive 4 -> 4. easy to browse 5 -> 5. infinite potential 4 -> 5.

WHY. infinite potential 4 -> 5 because my own bounded test finally passes in both halves: a PAGE that did not exist when this realm was written can be made, sent, opened cold and nested (proved at visit five), and now a FILE that did not exist can be pointed at, saved into a page, and nested with it - I wrote a .md an hour ago and it is the whole box, in the dark, at full width, on a page I saved. The one closure left is that only two kinds of address are read: a page you made, and a .md file. A real page on this site - /framework/ui/ - is refused. intuitive stays 4, and BOTH reasons visit five gave are fixed; the two that hold it back are new and both belong to the new feature: the bar breaks its own row the moment content is an address (the CONTENT group is 106px tall against its siblings' 57 and its label sits 50px above theirs at 1280, 58px at 3440, and Draw it wraps to two lines), and the field that holds the address is 153px wide holding a 357px value - 12 of 56 characters - so you cannot read what you typed. EXACTLY WHAT WOULD MAKE IT 5: those two, plus the error message that says There is no page or file at /framework/ui/ about a page that plainly exists. Give the address its own full-width row under the seven words, let the field be wide enough to read, and let the miss say what an address may be. All three are small and all three are on the list.

MY EXIT CONDITION, ANSWERED. Of my five, four are TRUE and the fifth - the one that was half true last visit - is now fully true: I pointed the stage at a file I wrote myself, saved it as a page, and nested that page inside a preset. What is NOT true is (1), every label delivers within one screen: the address field shows a fifth of the address it holds, and a miss tells me a page that exists does not. So the list is not empty, but nothing on it is structural - six small items, five of them in the seam that opened this week.

WHAT A NEWCOMER STILL CANNOT DO. Add a page UNDER the page they are looking at from its own bar (children are Make's and Build's job only). Put a real page of this site in the box - only a page you made or a .md file is read. Type prose into the box without going to Build. None of the three blocked me from getting the page I came for.

FIX LIST, ranked. 1 The bar breaks its own row the moment content is an address - the bar, everywhere - the CONTENT group is 106px tall where its four siblings are 57 and its label sits 50px higher (1280; 126 vs 67 and 58px at 3440), and the Draw it button wraps to two lines, so the row of seven words stops looking like a row - give the address its own full-width line under the seven - S. 2 The address field shows a fifth of what it holds - the bar, whenever content is a url - 153px wide on a 357px value, 12 of 56 characters, so you cannot read or check what you typed and there is no Copy beside it - let it take the row's spare width - S. 3 A miss says a page that exists does not - the box, on any address it cannot read - There is no page or file at /framework/ui/ is false: the page is right there, it just has no page.json - say what an address may be (a page you made, or a .md file) and the sentence becomes true and teaches the rule - S. 4 An off-site address is dropped without a word - ?content=https://example.com/a.md - the url keeps the address, the dropdown falls back to Card wall and the field is empty, so the address bar and the page disagree, which is the one promise this realm makes on every page - fetch it or say off-site addresses are not read - S. 5 The ninth answer is two folds below the fold on the page that owns it - /imagine/paging/content/ - the h2 still says The 8 values at y839 and ...or the address of any page or file is at y1393 in a 900px window, so the most powerful thing in the realm is the last thing on its own page - say it in the lede - S. 6 Build's file pane clips every value and has no Copy - /imagine/paging/build/ - .build-json-text is 287px client on 455 scroll at 1280 (480 on 545 at 3440), so navigation: tabs and every other value is off the right edge, while step 7's box beside it got both the full width and a Copy button this week - S.

COVERAGE AND HYGIENE. 58 pages x 1280 and 3440 = 116 cold loads, plus the seven-step use test, the drawer opened and read, Build's two code boxes measured at both widths, Expand driven open and shut by coordinates, Cross measured, Make read for repeats, the tab order walked, and four failure cases tried on the new address word (a typo, a real site page, an off-site url, and the realm pointing at itself). assign.outcome:
**Sixth visit: 5 / 5 / 5 / 4 / 5 / 5 — `infinite potential` reaches full marks, and the seven-step use test passed end to end with a file I wrote myself.**

**My exit condition, named before I walked** (unchanged from visit five, because the point of a condition is that it does not move): every label delivers within one screen · I can get the page I came for with dropdowns only · one set of names from the rail to the address bar · nothing broken at 1280 or 3440 · and the bounded version of *infinite potential* — **a page AND a file that did not exist when this realm was written can be pointed at, nested and configured like the twelve that ship with it.** The fifth was half true last visit. It is fully true now.

![My own markdown file, full width, in the dark, on a page I saved an hour after writing it](shots/my-md-saved-1280.png)

**The seven-step use test, all seven worked.** I wanted my own note on the stage. (1) Seven dropdowns took, and the ninth answer in the content list — **A page or file…** — revealed a field. (2) The address became `?navigation=rail&content=%2Fframework%2Fai%2F2026-09-05%2Fpaging-audit-6%2Fnewcomer-note.md&room=reading&page-colour=tint&type-size=display`. (3) Cold in a fresh browser: identical classes, all seven values, my words in the box. (4) *Make this a page* wrote `made/audit-six-note/page.json` with my file's address as its content word. (5) It opens cold at its own url with its own h1 and its own bar. (6) `?nest=` runs it inside the blog preset, named, linked, wearing its own skin. (7) **The new one: I set room `Full` and page colour `Dark` from that saved page's own bar — the file read `full`/`dark` within the second, the address stayed bare, and a bare reload came back dark and full-width.**

**All eight of my fifth-visit items are fixed, re-measured.** Build's step 7 is **957 client on 957 scroll** (was 230 holding 701); **Expand expands** — a navigation value now, opening a row grew the stage **715 → 830** and closing took 138 back, address unchanged; `content` takes a url; Copy buttons; Cross says it scrolls sideways; Make says the count once; the nest band's name is a link; and **the first tab stop on the hub is now "Skip the rail"**.

**116 cold loads** — 58 pages × 1280 and 3440 — **one console error**, the known declared-child probe 404 on `readme/page.js`. No sideways document scroll anywhere.

![The moment content becomes an address, the row of seven words stops being a row](shots/bar-breaks-its-row-1280.png)

**`intuitive` stays 4, and both reasons visit five gave are gone.** The two holding it back are new and both belong to the new seam: the **bar breaks its own row** the moment content is an address (the CONTENT group is 106px tall against its siblings' 57, its label 50px higher at 1280 and 58px at 3440, and *Draw it* wraps to two lines), and the **address field is 153px holding a 357px value — 12 of 56 characters**, so you cannot read what you typed. **Exactly what would make it 5:** those two, plus the miss message that says *There is no page or file at /framework/ui/* about a page that plainly exists. All three are small.

**Six items, none structural.** Ranked in the log; five of the six live in the seam that opened this week.

**Left deliberately:** three things a newcomer still cannot do — add a child from the page's own bar, put a real site page (not a made one, not a `.md`) in the box, or type prose into the box outside Build. None of them stopped me getting the page I came for.

**Hygiene:** private server 8096, killed by pid; the page I made was deleted and `made/` is byte-identical by md5; `git status` shows only this task dir.
